3296|c0e82349.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|c0e82349.text: Go to the cleft of shadow and seek out Spellweaver Mon'ye there, near the center of the district.

5624|de5818c9.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|de5818c9.text: Tiny goblin cut people in Trade Quarter on upper floor. Us no go there. Chair tiny like goblin.

1065-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
1065-progress.text: Ah, are you here with my new test subjects?
1065-progress.title: Journey to Tarren Mill

1066-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
1066-progress.text: Did you find the Syndicate Shadow Mages, and collect from them the blood?
1066-progress.title: Blood of Innocents

1067-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
1067-progress.text: You have returned, $N.  Do you bring aid from Apothecary Lydon?
1067-progress.title: Return to Thunder Bluff

1069-progress.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1069-progress.text: Did you get the eggs, $N?  I already made a shipping deal with Wharfmaster Dizzywig!
1069-progress.title: Deepmoss Spider Eggs

1093-progress.name: Ziz Fizziks
1093-progress.text: Did you find those plans? I'm eager to impress the new boss. Hopefully, once he's convinced of my loyalty--well, as much as he can be convinced... goblin's honor, you know?--he'll feel comfortable making use of my rather impressive genius.
1093-progress.title: Super Reaper 6000

1094-progress.name: Sputtervalve
1094-progress.text: Hello there! How can I help you?
1094-progress.title: Further Instructions

1131-progress.name: Melor Stonehoof
1131-progress.text: Have you defeated the foul Steelsnap, $N?
1131-progress.title: Steelsnap

1153-progress.name: Tatternack Steelforge
1153-progress.text:
I saw the travelers again--the ones that would not sell me a sample of the ore. I spit at them for not helping the warchief.

May they die in battle like cowards and not like warriors as should be the right of all people who ally themselves with the Horde.
1153-progress.title: A New Ore Sample

1486-progress.name: Nalpak
1486-progress.text: I am very interested in examining the hides from the deviate creatures who have infested these caves. Have you had any luck in collecting some, $c?
1486-progress.title: Deviate Hides

1824-progress.name: Ruga Ragetotem
1824-progress.text: Do you have the antennae?  If so then give them to me quickly, for twitching antennae do not twitch forever...
1824-progress.title: Trial at the Field of Giants

3083-progress.name: Rwag
3083-progress.text:
Welcome to the Valley of Trials, $N. You wouldn't be here if you hadn't gotten my tablet, so I will get to the point.

I am Rwag and I am responsible for training the rogues, thieves, and cutpurses here in the Valley. I'm the one the Hand will turn to if you're not ready for what's to come. But don't worry, the Hand won't be controlling everything you do, but it would be wise to work with them if they have need of your talents.
3083-progress.title: Encrypted Tablet

4542-progress.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
4542-progress.text: What do you want, $c? An urgent message - for me?
4542-progress.title: Message to Freewind Post

4767-progress.name: Elu
4767-progress.text: $N, have you retrieved the wyvern eggs that I seek? I'm really anxious to start my wind rider training!
4767-progress.title: Wind Rider

4821-progress.name: Hagar Lightninghoof
4821-progress.text: I must know more about this mysterious egg, who knows what will hatch from it.
4821-progress.title: Alien Egg

496-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
496-progress.text: I see you are back.  I hope you were able to gather the agents I need.  Another deathless day will put me in such a gloomy mood.
496-progress.title: Elixir of Suffering

501-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
501-progress.text: I remember you, $N.  You were going to help me out in concocting my latest elixir.  I'll need that blood before I can bring my own special brand of misery to the inhabitants of Hillsbrad.
501-progress.title: Elixir of Pain

5043-progress.name: Mangletooth
5043-progress.text:
My tribes greatest scouts are said to be unrivaled in their accuracy, and no rogue <snort> could measure up to their quickness in battle.

Bring me 4 blood shards and I will make you even more agile than any quilboar born.
5043-progress.title: Agamaggan's Agility

513-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
513-progress.text: Can you not see I am busy, $c?  The Dark Lady insists on a new plague before the Scourge advance from Northrend overwhelms us.  And with the human threat pressing from the south, time becomes my most precious commodity.  This better be important!
513-progress.title: Elixir of Agony

5147-progress.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
5147-progress.text: Have you any news of that murderous Arnak Grimtotem?
5147-progress.title: WANTED: Arnak Grimtotem

529-progress.name: High Executor Darthalia
529-progress.text: Were you able to carry out your orders, $c?  Did you dispose of Verringtan and his assistants?  And where is that iron shipment?
529-progress.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

546-progress.name: Deathguard Samsa
546-progress.text:
So the lucky $N returns?  How many humans have you slaughtered today?  Hundreds I do hope!

Have you any skulls for me?
546-progress.title: Souvenirs of Death

547-progress.name: Deathguard Humbert
547-progress.text: Were you able to retrieve my sword, $N?  High Executor Darthalia will hang me from the rafters if she discovers my folly.
547-progress.title: Humbert's Sword

550-progress.name: Varimathras
550-progress.text: What brings a $c all the way to the Undercity from the battlefield?
550-progress.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

552-progress.name: Novice Thaivand
552-progress.text: Have you recovered Helcular's Rod yet?  There are so many Yeti in this region, it will be very difficult to locate.  But we must have it in order to proceed.
552-progress.title: Helcular's Revenge

553-progress.name: Unknown
553-progress.text: Helcular's grave teems with a mystical energy.
553-progress.title: Helcular's Revenge

6284-progress.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6284-progress.text: Besseleth is a ruthless predator... I fear for those that travel Webwinder Path at night. It's then that she and her children prey upon innocent travelers. I myself fell prey to her two-foot fang of death, but luckily I was able to fend her off and get to safety. I would give anything to see that monster destroyed.
6284-progress.title: Arachnophobia

6561-progress.name: Bashana Runetotem
6561-progress.text:
May the Earthmother be with you, $N.

Peace between the earth and all her people should be our goal. She has a grand plan for nature, and we all have a role to play in that plan.
6561-progress.title: Blackfathom Villainy

6563-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6563-progress.text: How goes your search for the crystals, $N? Have you witnessed the naga harvesting them? I pray to my ancestors we find the reason they are collecting such things.
6563-progress.title: The Essence of Aku'Mai

6564-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6564-progress.text: Yes, $N? What is it you need? There is still much I must learn about the crystals the naga are gathering.
6564-progress.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods

6921-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6921-progress.text: Have you been successful in locating the fathom core?  Without it we'll have no idea what the Twilight's Hammer is exactly up to down there.
6921-progress.title: Amongst the Ruins

6922-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6922-progress.text: Ah, hello again $N.  I was just reading the waves the sea, much like I always do.  What brings you to the outpost?
6922-progress.title: Baron Aquanis

822-progress.name: Brewmaster Drohn
822-progress.text: You working hard at finding those ingredients, $N?
822-progress.title: Chen's Empty Keg

843-progress.name: Gann Stonespire
843-progress.text: Many innocent $r lost their lives or were forced off their ancestral birthplace when the dwarves of Bael Modan arrived. My land must be reclaimed!
843-progress.title: Gann's Reclamation

846-progress.name: Gann Stonespire
846-progress.text:
I see you are back, $N.

While Khazgorm's death might delay the digging in my ancestral lands some, it will by no means bring a total end to the destruction.

The Keep at Bael Modan is an increasing military threat. Built to defend the dig site, it is now poised for offensive force as well.

If you have the ingredients I requested, I can fashion a charge that will make the hasty dwarves reconsider their actions here in the Barrens.
846-progress.title: Revenge of Gann

850-progress.name: Regthar Deathgate
850-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Do you have Barak's Head for me?
850-progress.title: Kolkar Leaders

857-progress.name: Feegly the Exiled
857-progress.text: Where is the Tear of the Moons? I need it now! Need I say!
857-progress.title: The Tear of the Moons

866-progress.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
866-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Did you get those root samples?
866-progress.title: Root Samples

868-progress.name: Korran
868-progress.text: Be careful with the eggs you find, $N. If they break, they be no good to me.
868-progress.title: Egg Hunt

879-progress.name: Mangletooth
879-progress.text:
How goes your hunt, $r? <snort>

Thork thinks he knows the truth about who leads the raids against his people, <snort> but he shall learn how wrong he is if you are successful.

My death is inescapable, but you have caused great pain to my enemies, so Mangletooth regrets nothing. <snort>
879-progress.title: Betrayal from Within

883-progress.name: Jorn Skyseer
883-progress.text: $N, when you approached I saw a new power in your stride.  Tell me -- has your spirit met with the great Lakota'mani?
883-progress.title: Lakota'mani

884-progress.name: Jorn Skyseer
884-progress.text: $N, there is a new power behind your eyes!  You have met with the mighty Owatanka, have you not?
884-progress.title: Owatanka

885-progress.name: Jorn Skyseer
885-progress.text:
There is new resolve within you, $N.  A resolve born from pain...

Are you burdened with the death of Washte Pawne?
885-progress.title: Washte Pawne

891-progress.name: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun
891-progress.text: My fleet is in peril with Captain Fairmount and her damned cannoneers blasting away from Northwatch Hold. I want her soldiers to pay as well. Fill my hand with medals from their dead and I will know that vengeance has been given to my fallen privateers.
891-progress.title: The Guns of Northwatch

893-progress.name: Tatternack Steelforge
893-progress.text:
I, too, have doubts that the pathetic quilboars could attain any level of skill in the area of smithing, but I do as the Warchief commands, and I shall learn what I can about the Razormane tribe.

I have had more menial tasks, and I do so willingly if it aids the orc people.
893-progress.title: Weapons of Choice

913-progress.name: Jorn Skyseer
913-progress.text: Is it done? Have you slain the thunderhawk?
913-progress.title: Cry of the Thunderhawk

95204-complete.name: Oran Snakewrithe
95204-complete.text:
<Oran bites the crest to ensure authenticity.>

Well I'll be. A genuine relic of our home. Mostly intact, too. We need to be extra careful with this one.

Thank you for your aid in restoring our history, $c. I'll see to it that we take good care of this.
95204-complete.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95204-progress.name: Oran Snakewrithe
95204-progress.text: What have you got there, $c? A tasty morsel?
95204-progress.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95216-complete.name: Theodore Griffs
95216-complete.text:
You killed it??

Hmmph. Lucky for you this should be enough ichor to reverse engineer its properties. I would have expected more from a fellow alchemist.

Get out of my sight!
95216-complete.title: The New Plague

95663-accept.name: Spiceknot
95663-accept.text:
The Dragonmaw are a formidable clan.

They're known for binding magic strong enough to make dragons serve, and rumor claims they're preparing some display of it in the Wetlands. Whether truth or bluster, the Deathstalkers can't act on half-formed whispers. Titanic winds carried only that much to me.

A deathstalker agent needs a hand in the hills above the Dragonmaw encampment. Meet her there. She'll reveal the next steps.
95663-accept.title: Dragonmaw Rumors

95664-progress.name: Bashana Runetotem
95664-progress.text: Spirits honor you. Have you come to share with us?
95664-progress.title: Elder Knowledge

95682-progress.name: Deathstalker Agent
95682-progress.text: We're here to get the important job done. If you can help, prove it.
95682-progress.title: Open the Maw

95697-accept.name: Spiceknot
95697-accept.text:
Zamja tells me we need more homestyle cooking.
If we start selling raptor, she thinks it'll draw in customers who don't usually visit Borstan's Firepit.

Her idea is not so bad. But I want something that rises above the smells of our birth villages. We're in Orgrimmar! Borstan should serve a grand take on their familiar favorites.

A hunter recently came back from the Wetlands with a giant talon from the thicket raptors in the Excavation Sites.

Up for a job?
95697-accept.title: Changing Tastes

95697-progress.name: Borstan
95697-progress.text: Farm-raised boar, farm-raised crawler... what's next, farm-raised raptor?
95697-progress.title: Changing Tastes

96774-accept.name: Mazu'kon
96774-accept.text:
The ancient Gurubashi of Stranglethorn Vale were da masters of dark blood magics. Rumors be they'd use pure truesilver idols to channel that bad bad voodoo.

Ol' Mazu'kon would love to get his hands on one of those idols... for academics ya see. How 'bout you gather some friends and do a bit of smash and grab on that drowned city stickin' out the ocean off the coast of Stranglethorn? Kill the most impressive lookin' priest ya can find in there, and they sure to have what I be lookin' for.
96774-accept.title: Ancient Gurubashi Idol

96986-accept.name: Melisara
96986-accept.text:
Within the underbelly of the mage city to the north is a traitor to our kind. A necromancer of disturbing talent. He raises an army of undeath right under the Kirin Tor's nose.

I care not for the fate of the mage city, $N, but this grave knight spits in the face of everything we Forsaken stand for. Put an end to him. Show him no one is beyond the reach of the Dark Lady.
96986-accept.title: The Grave Knight

96988-accept.name: Doctor Martin Felben
96988-accept.text:
With the city of Dalaran under siege by their own constructs, this is the perfect opportunity to, let's say, borrow a few samples.

Imagine an army of arcane-powered abominations. The Dark Lady would have no choice but to recognize my alchemical prowess. Maybe even grant me head of the Royal Apothecary Society?

Go to the city and find the constructs' cores. They are unlikely to give them willingly, so do what you must.
96988-accept.title: Source of Power

97289-accept.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97289-accept.text:
We craft abomination heads all the time, but this one is special. It belonged to a Grand Marshal of the Alliance once. A particularly unpleasant one. Othmar, I believe its name was. The Dark Lady had the pleasure of dispatching this one herself.

Ooh the secrets it could tell if it could talk. And it can! If we reattach it to an appropriate host.

Go ahead and place it next to the available body in the next room. But don't attach it. Not yet.
97289-accept.title: Unending Torment

97292-accept.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97292-accept.text:
I have concocted a lovely serum that our new guest is sure to find quite... stimulating.

Take this. Feed it into the workings dripping from above him. Let's see if we can't show him why it's in his best interest to serve loyally.

And try not to drop it. I can't afford a new assistant.
97292-accept.title: Unending Torment

97985-accept.name: Calder Gray
97985-accept.text:
Fascinating, aren't they? This is the first time I have ever been privy to the secrets of abomination creation.

I have been studying these notes, and it appears we need a heart. A massive one!

I hear there is a thunder lizard there of impressive size called Stormheart, that patrols along the canyon edge in Thousand Needles. With a name like that it must have the perfect heart. I must have that heart!

Oh, also I suggest you bring friends. Stormheart isn't known for being docile.
97985-accept.title: Thundering Hearts

98069-accept.name: Jandia
98069-accept.text:
Those wretched harpies! They attacked the last caravan I had scheduled to deliver supplies to Freewind Post. We have enough supplies for the moment, but without more supplies, we'll run short soon.

I'm not sure what the harpies plan to do with the extra supplies, but I would be grateful if you would recover them for me. They make their lair west of here. They can be found both at the base of the cliffside and inside a cave at the top.
98069-accept.title: Stolen Freewind Supplies

98069-progress.name: Jandia
98069-progress.text: Have you been able to recover the supplies the harpies stole?
98069-progress.title: Stolen Freewind Supplies

98070-accept.name: Jandia
98070-accept.text:
The Screeching Canyon is home to a local band of harpies known for their ferocious nature and raiding tactics. They have ambushed the last few supply caravans that have been brave enough to traverse this place.

I fear if something isn't done soon, there will be no caravans that will dare make the trek to Freewind Post.

Go, slay as many of these harpies as you are able. Return to me once the deed has been done, and I will reward you well for your efforts.
98070-accept.title: Stop the Screeching

98093-complete.name: Sulhasa
98093-complete.text:
Thank you for helping me out, $N. I'll let Camp Taurajo know you were able to rescue me. I'm so lucky you helped, I could have been stuck there all day!

This is all I have to spare, but I hope it's useful to you.

I'll be making my exit once I make the careful climb down.
98093-complete.title: Field to Clear

98094-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
98094-accept.text:
Now that we can trust you to deliver critical information to our forward spies, there's an extra task for you.

Bring this to Deathstalker Masoj almost directly south of us. He'll have more for you to do once you get there and hand this to him. He is posted on elevated terrain north of the rotten vineyard they call Nethander Stead.

Our plan to take control of these lands continues steadily.
98094-accept.title: Scout Support

98094-complete.name: Deathstalker Masoj
98094-complete.text:
Quaint. A fresh face for the field work.

Well, let's see what you have then.
98094-complete.title: Scout Support

98095-accept.name: Deathstalker Masoj
98095-accept.text:
Our high command inserts strategic troops using bat riders. Key points around the foothills have lost their signaling beacons.

Take these vials. Uncork them in three locations: the hills bordering Dun Garok, the plateau overlooking Dunholde Keep, and the last on the ridge of the Headland above the town of Hillsbrad. The vapors that emanate will be like a potent tuning rod to the senses of the bat, drawing them to the desired drop-off points once more.

Look for crushed empty vials and renew our marks.
98095-accept.title: Valuable Vantages

98095-complete.name: Deathstalker Masoj
98095-complete.text:
Good work. We advance the plans.

Deathstalkers dare.

Let purpose guide your strikes, $N.
98095-complete.title: Valuable Vantages

98823-complete.name: Muln Earthfury
98823-complete.text:
Ah... this shard hums with the voice of the world itself. The light within is a memory from the past, glimmering with flashes of history. This titan machine must have been waiting to be understood for lifetimes.

You've done wisely to bring it to us. The Earthen Ring will safeguard it, study it, and share the truths it keeps when we are able to receive its messages.

You honor the elements today, traveler.
98823-complete.title: Earthen Echo

99196-progress.name: Oura Stormspinner
99196-progress.text:
The Windshapers are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.

A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Windshapers for your generosity. 

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
99196-progress.title: A Donation of Wool
